notes.title: UP & OVER: Trial of the Gods (New Update Completed)
notes.content:
UP & OVER is evolving into a more thrilling and immersive adventure, bringing major changes to its gameplay.

We are making significant updates to characters, controls, and map design to create a more engaging and dynamic experience. The controls will feel more intuitive and responsive, and the level design will enhance the sense of exploration and challenge, making each jump more exciting.

Additionally, we are actively exploring ways to incorporate environmental changes with each jump and introduce distinct difficulty levels for different routes. While these elements are still being refined, we aim to ensure that player choices have a meaningful impact, with divine blessings and curses shaping the journey.

UP & OVER is constantly evolving beyond just a jumping game, offering an experience where choice and challenge go hand in hand. Stay tuned for the exciting changes ahead, and thank you for your support—we’re committed to making the game even more fun!
